content: {"praised":["Production values and scripts remained intact over decades.","Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels portrayed authentic Lone Ranger and Tonto.","Picture and sound quality were good.","Episodes showcased true story of law and order.","Fans enjoyed classic Western adventure."],"criticized":["Lost essential spirit of original Lone Ranger story.","Focused on gags, effects, narrow escapes.","Shows compressed, sounding like a cartoon.","Came off as a joke, not serious.","Not as originally aired, disappointing."]}
